annotations.title: Check whether a file is marked by Proofestry

description: Free. Checks a file for Proofestry's marks: the C2PA manifest (validated against Proofestry's records), the invisible watermark, and an exact fingerprint of files Proofestry delivered. Reports what was found; not finding marks never means a file is unmarked. Up to 4 MiB. MCP tool: `verify_provenance`.
name: verify_provenance
title: Check whether a file is marked by Proofestry
